prerequisites: Student has a basic knowledge of mathematics and physics at secondary school level
Student has the ability to read drawings and diagrams contained in the technical documentation.
Student has basic knowledge in the design of machine elements. It has a basic knowledge of manufacturing techniques of machine parts.

learning_outcomes.text: It can identify the quantity associated with of the geometrical description of the product, can name units of measure used to describe them, know diferences between universal and dedicated equipment for the measurement of geometrical quantities, know how to describe its metrological characteristics. He knows and is able to explain the terms used in metrology of geometrical quantities.
Able to define the elements of the measurement process and their impact on the result of the measurement.
Knows the specific, standardized quantities are subject of measurements of a different typical machine manufacturing techniques.

Understands the dimensional requirements imposed to products included in the technical documentation. Can use standards for tolerances and fits linear and geometric tolerances. It can calculate the value of measurement errors, estimated measurement uncertainty for the different measurements.
He can make the selection of appropriate test equipment and set it up depending on the task measuring. Can use measuring equipment used in engineering to measure the geometrical quantities.
Able to solve the basic problems of the practical use of the tools and of measuring. Able to recognize sources of error, their values, and estimate the uncertainty of measurement.
Search for information and its critical analysis
Team collaboration on improving the method of selection of strategies aimed at optimal solution entrusted of problems to a group.
Objective evaluation of arguments, the rational explanation of his own point of view using the knowledge of metrology.

syllabus_topics: Organizational matters. Basic concepts of metrology. Quantities and units of measurement. Integrated measurement units. SI units, measurement standards, a hierarchical system of measurement standards.
Measurement, measurement types, method and measurement principle.
Errors and their sources. The types of errors. Distributions of errors variability. Methods of estimation and expression of uncertainty in measurement.
Dimensions, tolerance of linear dimensions and fits.
GPS - geometrical tolerance according to ISO 1101. Geometrical deviations measurements.
Description of geometric structure of surfaces - roughness and waviness, and their measurement.
Tolerance and machine parts measurement.
Tolerating and measurements of machines parts manufactured in the process of: casting, plastic forming, welding, plastics processing.
Classification of the measuring equipment, the metrological characteristics and methods of assessment.
Methods and means of mechanization and automation of measurements.
Analysis of dimension. Fundamentals of statistical control of dimensions.
Fundamentals of coordinate measurement techniques.
Organizational matters. General principles for the use of measuring equipment.
Errors of measurement and assessment methods of measurement uncertainty.
Measurements of linear dimensions.
Measurements of angular dimensions.
Direct and indirect measurements of cones.
Identification and measurement of threads.
Project of a tests.
Assessment of the geometrical structure of the surface.
Identification and measurement of cylindrical gears.
Measurements of selected shape deviations.
Measurements of selected displacement.
Cams measurement.
Measurements of machine parts with pneumatic measurement equipment.
Verification of measuring instruments
Coordinate measurements of machine parts.
teaching_methods: traditional lecture with the use of transparencies and slides
self study - preparation for laboratory class
assessment_rules: For the lecture, evaluation is based on a test (F1). The final concluding grade (P) for the lecture is equal to F1. For the laboratory, evaluation is based on reports on laboratory exercises, a test, and an oral answer (F1). The final concluding grade (P) for the laboratory is equal to F1.
